content: 1. Aluminum hydroxide reduces the levels of levofloxacin by inhibiting gastrointestinal (GI) absorption. This interaction is specific to the oral forms of both agents. It is recommended to avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, separate the doses by at least 2 hours and monitor closely. 2. Aluminum hydroxide decreases the levels of levoketoconazole by inhibiting GI absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution, monitor closely, or consider alternative therapy. If co-administration is unavoidable, separate the doses by 2 hours. 3. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Monitor closely if co-administration is necessary. 4. Salicylate levels may increase at moderate doses and decrease at high doses due to increased renal excretion of unchanged salicylic acid. 9.
